title: Bollobás-type inequalities for subspaces via weight invariance
summary: Let $V$ be an $n$-dimension real vector space with a direct sum decomposition $V = V_1 \oplus \cdots \oplus V_r$. Let $\mathcal{P} = \{(A_i, B_i) : i \in [m]\}$ be a skew Bollobás system of subspaces of $V$ such that each $i\in [m]$, $ A_i = \bigoplus_{k=1}^r (A_i \cap V_k)$ and $ B_i = \bigoplus_{k=1}^r (B_i \cap V_k)$. We prove that $$\sum_{i=1}^{m} \prod_{k=1}^{r} \left[ \binom{a_{i,k} + b_{i,k}}{a_{i,k}} (1 + a_{i,k} + b_{i,k})^{-1} \right] \leq 1,$$ where $a_{i,k} = \dim(A_i \cap V_k)$ and $b_{i,k} = \dim(B_i \cap V_k)$.
